summary: Leading eigenvalues of the NACA 0012 steady flow at Re = 2000. The flow is stable: the leading pair is sigma = -0.0665 +- 8.006 i and the next stable pair sigma = -0.557 +- 9.433 i lies further in the stable half-plane.
description: Regression value of this repository (not a literature value): leading pair and the stable pair sigma = -0.557 +- 9.433 i of the NACA 0012 steady flow at Re=2000. The pair is read by row: row 9 of Spectre_NSd_conv.dat (row 8 is its conjugate), because check_against_ref.py cannot select a row by value. The rows come from schur_tgt 8, maxmodes 10, k_dim 240; a run with other settings may order the rows differently.
